text:
riley: Quick sync 1 Were launching an OSS dev content pack: hands-on codelab + live benchmark webinar next Thu. Need launch post, short benchmark blurb, webinar copy (2 headlines), and lead routing into HubSpot. Who volunteers?
sam: Ill take the launch post + short benchmark summary. Will keep the bench non-technical and add a 1-sentence dev takeaway for social.
anya: I can wire form -> HubSpot + UTM mapping. Suggest utm_source=oss_pack, utm_campaign=oss_launch_q2. Ill add a tag rule for role selection.
morgan: Ill do webinar page copy and two headline variants. Also can produce a one-line chart caption: "p95 latency down 30% vs baseline; cost per 1k tokens reduced 40%" (placeholder until bench confirmed).
cleo-bot: Reminder: staging page deploy scheduled 2025-04-10T16:00Z.
riley: Two quick asks: 1) Sam: include p50/p95 and cost per 1k tokens in plain language. 2) Anya: add tracking snippet + confirm test lead appears.
sam: Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood/oss-content/pull/108 contains post + bench table + tweet blurb.
anya: Will add tracking now and post screenshot of test lead here.
morgan: Headline options: A) "Hands-on codelab: build a low-latency chat app with Redwood" B) "Ship a production chat app: OSS codelab + live benchmarks" Leaning A. CTA: "Register to follow the build and see live benchmarks."
riley: Great. Target to publish Tues so emails can go out Wed. Sam, finalize copy by EOD. Anya, confirm tracking. Morgan, pick primary headline.
sam: Pushed final copy and 35-word dev takeaway into PR.
anya: Test lead received in HubSpot screenshot attached. Tracking OK.miley: (typo) Nice catch. All set to schedule emails. :thumbsup:
